nodes.title: APPLIED AI NEWS — Audio-First Anchor
widgets_values:
# Applied AI News — Audio-First Anchor

**Target:** up to 20 seconds. Default 20 s at 24 fps = 481 frames.
This candidate exposes one creative prompt only. Internal blank negative conditioning is hidden.

**Inputs**
1. Upload AVATAR / CHARACTER if making an anchor.
2. Upload SCENE / B-ROLL IMAGE if using a non-avatar image reference.
3. Upload MASTER AUDIO when `Use Uploaded Master Audio` is ON.
4. Enter one SCRIPT / VIDEO REQUEST and leave Prompt Enhance ON unless exact visual wording must be preserved.

Audio-first mode follows the official LTX-2.5 A2V pattern: uploaded audio is VAE-encoded and frozen against diffusion noise while the original trimmed waveform is muxed back to the output.

Default working resolution: 704×384.



IMPORTANT: This JSON is statically validated here, but cannot be runtime-tested against your local ComfyUI from this environment.

nodes.title: SCRIPT / VIDEO REQUEST — ONE PROMPT
widgets_values: Professional Applied AI News anchor. Preserve the reference character strongly. Natural restrained presenter motion, direct-to-camera delivery, stable studio composition.
